goal: Implement the native Android session list and core session actions for the Phase 2 user loop.
non_goals: Do not implement new-session templates or custom profile creation; those belong to NATIVE-P2-002.
Do not implement chat timeline, composer, quote, or message actions; those belong to NATIVE-P2-003.
Do not implement real export payload generation; expose a safe disabled/placeholder export entry only.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Sessions screen renders real native session list state instead of the generic placeholder.
Session list supports search/filter, pinned-first ordering, status/unread metadata, and avatar visibility placeholders.
Session actions include open, rename, pin/unpin, delete with destructive confirmation, export entry placeholder, and avatar action placeholder.
Session mutations persist through Room-backed DAO/repository behavior.
Empty state and deferred proactive/LLM states are explicit and safe.
Repository/DAO tests cover rename, pin/unpin, delete/archive behavior, and list ordering.
UI/state tests cover search/filter/action state without requiring real LLM calls.
Legacy coverage registry is updated conservatively for LEG-005, LEG-006, LEG-007, and LEG-038.
verification_expectations: Follow TDD: add failing tests before production implementation for repository/session action behavior.
Run focused core data tests and feature chat/app JVM tests.
Run connected core data instrumentation if an ADB device is available.
Run native project test, lint, and app assembleDebug.
Install preview debug APK on the connected device and capture session-list/action smoke evidence when feasible.
Use app pid/package-specific logcat filtering to avoid global AndroidRuntime false positives.
Validate ADworkflo JSON artifacts with ConvertFrom-Json.
notes: This task starts the Phase 2 core user loop but does not complete the full chat loop.
Export and avatar actions may be visible but must be labeled as deferred until their owning tasks implement the payload/picker behavior.
Proactive behavior remains a product open question, so the UI should show an explicit deferred/disabled state rather than pretending it is active.
